errors.evidence: The description misstates the y-axis range as the data range ("0.1 to 0.9179") instead of the actual axis range (0 to 1), and vaguely states the unit is "represented by the chart itself" instead of explicitly mentioning the label "F1值" (F1 score).
The blue line is labeled "新冠疫情" (COVID-19 pandemic) in the legend, not "新策略" (New Strategy).
The red line is labeled "亚裔歧视" (Asian discrimination) in the legend, not "正常模型" (Normal Model).
The blue line does not decrease from x=1 to x=2; it increases from 0.6416 to a peak of 0.7012. The description misses the peak and reports the trend incorrectly. The value 0.5965 is at x=3, not x=2.
For the blue line, the F1 value at GCN layer 3 is 0.5965, not 0.3686. The value 0.3686 is at GCN layer 4.
For the blue line, the F1 value at GCN layer 4 is 0.3686, not 0.2122. The value 0.2122 is at GCN layer 5.
The F1 value for the blue line at GCN layer 5 is 0.2122. The value 0.03417 is an incorrect reading of 0.3417, which belongs to the red line.
The F1 value for the blue line at GCN layer 6 is 0.2122, not 0.02122.
The red line increases from x=1 (0.8459) to x=2 (0.9179), it does not decrease. The value 0.7012 belongs to the blue line at x=2.
For the red line, the F1 value at GCN layer 3 is 0.5229, not 0.3417. The value 0.3417 is at GCN layer 5.
For the red line, the F1 value at GCN layer 4 is 0.3904, not 0.2122. The value 0.2122 belongs to the blue line.
For the red line, the F1 value at GCN layer 5 is 0.3417, not 0.03417.
For the red line, the F1 value at GCN layer 6 is 0.3331, not 0.02122. The value 0.02122 is an incorrect reading of the value for the blue line.
